rust_summary: A player's damaging melee hit decides whether it sweeps (`native_sweep_attack`).
doc_summary: A player's damaging melee hit is about to sweep or not, after `native_critical_hit`: `native_sweep_attack(target, vanilla_sweep, sweeping, canceled)` may force the sweep (any held item, even a critical hit) or stop it; `canceled` stops it whatever `sweeping` says. A critical hit that sweeps plays both sounds. Bundles need "hooks": @API:sweep_attack@.
